facts.text: Audrey mentions that her pets have been her good ol' buddies during tough times and make her happy.

evidence.quote: My pets have been my good ol' buddies during all the tough times! They make me so happy and I love them so much.

facts.text: Audrey states that humans and animals have a cool connection that brings joy and love, and she is blessed to have her furry friends in her life.

evidence.quote: Humans and animals have a cool connection. They bring us so much joy and love. I'm blessed to have my furry friends in my life.

facts.text: Audrey mentions that she never really asked what breed Toby is, referring to her pet.

evidence.quote: Btw, I never really asked, what breed is Toby?

facts.text: Andrew expresses a desire to experience a deep bond with Toby, his future pet, similar to the bond Audrey has with her pets.

evidence.quote: Hoping for the day I can have such a deep bond with Toby and experience that special bond too.
